title: 连接您的马上赢品牌CT账号
description: 请填写马上赢品牌CT的个人访问令牌（PAT）。凭证仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录，不会上传到云端，权限范围与您本人的账号一致。
description_en: Enter your Mashangying BrandCT personal access token (PAT). The credential is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only and never uploaded to the cloud. Its scope matches your own account permissions.

fields.label: 个人访问令牌
fields.description: 登录马上赢品牌CT后，打开 https://x.brandct.com/generalSettings/personalAccessTokens ，点击生成令牌并复制完整令牌串，粘贴到此处。
